Create one sophisticated luxury-fashion visualization of a Small Leather Good. Identity contract: Rigid leather rings form a reconfigurable skeleton while one continuous leather element binds them into a flexible skin. Changing how many rings are engaged mechanically changes capacity and silhouette. The product remains a functional small leather good capable of carrying contents. At least one continuous strap must pass through and bind functional rigid rings; rings cannot be ornamental appliques. Approved redesign: Use fewer, more precisely graduated rings with controlled overlaps and a clear transformation path. Resolve a compact vertical clutch state and a broader low basket state with one continuous visual identity. Use deep polished blue rings, a restrained yellow binding line, and nearly invisible precision hardware. Express strong proportions, material credibility, controlled novelty, intentional color, visual hierarchy, restraint, and plausible premium execution. The structural mechanism must remain operative and recognizable, never a decorative imitation. Do not change category, merge concepts, substitute a conventional product, or claim validated manufacturability or commercial readiness. One coherent product; no logos or text.
Variation 1 — architectural_clarity: Make the evaluated mechanism immediately legible through a disciplined, architectural silhouette and controlled luxury proportions.
Render one coherent product only, with no logos, captions, or text.
